Patch management, administration, and deployment. Maintaining standard ESXi image configuration. Experience in performance tuning of VMware servers, Virtual sessions, and management of server resources between virtual machines. Working with Enterprise Backup & Restore Processes (Familiarity with Cohesity Appliance). Good Understanding of ITIL Processes (Incident/Change/Problem Management) and operates within agreed SLAs & good documentation skills with regular focus on maintaining KEDB/KMDB. Maintaining skills to the current industry level of certification. Self-motivation and strong communication skills, both verbal and written, are key attributes for this position. Ability to handle multiple tasks, set priorities, schedule, and meet deadlines (work under pressure and prioritize tasks). Qualifications Minimum 6+ years proven experience of managing large enterprise level VMware Environment. Working with virtualization technologies, such as VMware, Nutanix (Prism Central, Prism Element, AOS, NCC, Foundation, LCM), UCS & vSAN, vROPs, vLog Insight, VRO. Clear understanding of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NIC Teaming and distributed switches. Working understanding of SAN, NAS, NFS, VMFS, iSCSI. Experience in VMware Guests, Templates, P2V, Capacity Planner, VMotion, HA, DRS, etc. Good Understanding of Virtual infrastructure security Hardening & compliance including certificates for the overall virtualized environment. Experience on Dell, Intel, Cisco, HP Servers and associated management tools like, Dell OME/SAE, HP OneView. Basic understanding on cloud service platforms and concepts around the same.
